description.zh: 鬼怒川温泉是栃木县著名的温泉胜地，天然温泉水质优良，融入壮美的自然山水之中，是放松身心、体验日本温泉文化的绝佳去处。
description.en: Kinugawa Onsen is a celebrated hot-spring resort in Tochigi Prefecture, where high-quality natural onsen waters meet scenic mountain landscapes — an ideal destination for relaxation and experiencing Japanese bath culture.

zh: 温泉
放松
日本文化
en: Hot Spring
Onsen
Relaxation

zh: 温泉浴场：多种成分与温度的天然温泉，适合不同喜好的泡汤体验
自然美景：温泉区周边的山川峡谷风光，与泡汤体验完美结合
传统旅馆：选择入住温泉旅馆，体验日式款待（おもてなし）的极致
en: Hot spring baths: natural onsen pools of varying mineral compositions and temperatures
Scenic surroundings: mountain and gorge scenery perfectly complements the bathing experience
Traditional ryokan: staying at a hot-spring inn delivers the ultimate Japanese hospitality (omotenashi) experience

admission.zh: 日归浴场约500—3,000日元；住宿另计

duration.zh: 半天至一天（住宿则更长）
duration.en: Half-day to full day (longer if staying overnight)

tips.zh: 傍晚浸泡温泉最为惬意。建议提前查询各浴场的纹身限制政策。
tips.en: Evening is the most relaxing time for a soak. Check in advance regarding tattoo restrictions.

Surroundings: the area around the landmark typically offers plentiful dining, shopping and cultural resources

description.zh: 中禅寺湖是栃木县的壮美自然景观，以其独特的地理风貌与四季变换的自然之美而著称，是亲近大自然、享受户外体验的理想目的地。
description.en: Lake Chūzenji is a magnificent natural landscape in Tochigi Prefecture, celebrated for its distinctive geographical features and seasonal beauty — an ideal destination for nature-lovers and outdoor enthusiasts.

zh: 自然景观
户外
风景
en: Nature
Outdoor
Scenic

zh: 壮美景观：无论山川湖泊还是峡谷瀑布，皆令人叹为观止
户外活动：远足、骑行、垂钓等户外体验，让人与自然亲密接触
四季之美：随着季节更迭，自然景观呈现出迥然不同的色彩与氛围
en: Breathtaking scenery: mountains, lakes, canyons or waterfalls that command awe
Outdoor activities: hiking, cycling, fishing and other experiences that bring visitors close to nature
Seasonal changes: the landscape transforms dramatically with each season

tips.zh: 出发前查询天气预报，并准备合适的户外装备。
tips.en: Check the weather forecast before heading out and bring appropriate outdoor gear.
